question: Which one of the following is the range of \( f(x) = \ln \frac{8 + x}{8 - x} \)?
explanation:

Since the natural logarithm of any positive number is a real number, the range is all real numbers, \( \mathbb{R} \).

(iii) \( (x-y)^2 = x^2 + y^2 - 2xy = 7xy - 2xy = 5xy \Rightarrow 2\log|x-y| = \log(5xy) \). True (assuming \( x, y > 0 \)).
